rules: Use monospace font for all callsigns, DMR IDs, coordinates, numerical data, and raw data logs.
Use condensed uppercase for section headers and widget titles with tight tracking.
Never center-align data tables or logs; always left-align or align by decimal/column.
Use 1px borders to separate sections. No soft shadows. Tactical minimalism.
Text over the map should use backdrop blur or dark solid background for maximum contrast.
Highlight recently updated rows in the roster with a brief flash of radar_green.

layouts.structure: Full-height (100vh) application layout with no global page scroll. Hide scrollbars where possible using custom CSS.
areas: Header/TopBar: App identity, Global connection status, MMDVM listener status (Port 62031).
Sidebar (Left): Radio Roster / Last-Heard list. Extremely dense, optimized for scanning.
Main Center: Leaflet Map occupying the largest visual area. Must show Position history trails (polylines).
Sidebar (Right) / Bottom Panel: Split between Multi-brand GPS parser status, Simulated Injector, and Raw Packet Log terminal.
layouts.spacing: Tight padding (p-2 to p-4) to maximize data density on screen, but maintain 1px grid borders.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use solid flat backgrounds with 1px border `border-border/40`. No rounded corners (use `rounded-none`).
visual_enhancers.effects: Terminal aesthetic for raw packet log. High contrast active states.
animations: Pulsing animation (`animate-ping`) on the MMDVM connection status dot.
Radar blip animation on map markers when a new GPS packet is received.
New rows in the raw packet log should slide in smoothly.

components.Map: Use react-leaflet with a dark mode tile layer (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter). Use custom divIcons for radio markers with pulsing rings. Draw polylines for history trails.
components.Radio Roster: A dense list/table. Show Callsign (bold), DMR ID (mono, muted), RSSI (signal bar indicator), and relative time (e.g., '2s ago').
components.Parser Status Panel: A grid showing status of Motorola LRRP, Hytera RRS, NMEA, APRS. Use neon lights (green for active/parsing, gray for inactive).
components.Raw Packet Log: Terminal-like window (black bg, green/gray mono text, overflow-y-auto). Color-code prefixes like [LRRP] or [APRS].
components.Radio Detail Modal: Use Shadcn Dialog. Show last N positions in a mini data table, speed, heading, and first/last heard timestamps.
components.Simulated Injector: A functional panel with an 'Inject Mock Data' button to trigger simulated DMR radio packets to populate the map and roster.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio over dark backgrounds.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the map marker pulsing and terminal auto-scroll.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements and key metric displays MUST include `data-testid`.

instructions_to_main_agent: For the Leaflet map, you need to import Leaflet CSS manually. Use the tile layer URL: `https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png` for the dark tactical map.
Fix Leaflet marker icon issues by using custom `L.divIcon` with Tailwind classes instead of default image markers.
For the dashboard layout, use CSS Grid or Flexbox to fill the entire viewport height (`h-screen overflow-hidden`).
Implement the 'Simulated GPS Injector' to periodically add fake radio data (mocked positions, RSSI, format) to the state so the map, polyline trails, roster, and logs actually populate and animate.
Ensure the raw packet log looks like a real terminal console (monospace, dark bg). Provide a mocked live-feed of packets.
DO NOT apply global `.App { text-align: center; }`. Keep text left-aligned.
Use a robust mock state management approach to simulate the real-time nature of this dashboard.
Apply `rounded-none` to all shadcn UI components (buttons, dialogs) to maintain the tactical SDR look.
Highlight specific data formats (Motorola LRRP, Hytera RRS) with different colors in the raw log.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but rely on borders rather than shadows for this technical look.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Always use modern button styles, for this app use sharp corners and tactical high-contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-tactical_cyan hover:text-black).
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
